title: Multi-part DXF from nested sheet-metal parts
summary: Layered DXF, one per stock sheet, with every nested part placed and oriented — closes the loop from nesting to shop-ready manufacturing artifact.
details:
## What's New

- **`nested_dxf(placements)`** in `vcad-kernel-sheet::dxf`: takes a slice of `NestedPlacement { flat, sheet, dx_mm, dy_mm, rotated }` and emits one DXF string per stock sheet. Same `CUT` / `BEND_UP` / `BEND_DOWN` layer convention as the single-part exporter so shop post-processors don't have to learn a new dialect.
- **`nestedSheetMetalDxf` WASM binding** accepting `[{chain, sheet, dx_mm, dy_mm, rotated}]` JSON — each part's chain is independently evaluated, translated, optionally rotated 90°, and written into its sheet's DXF.

With `sheet_metal_nest` returning placements and this binding turning them into per-sheet DXF, a nested job is one tool call away from a quote-able artifact.
